item.description:
New • Actvt now knows the moment a Claude Code session needs you. A permission prompt or a question shows the session as waiting within seconds, not after 90 seconds of quiet, and a long, quiet tool call no longer reads as your turn. This uses the status newer Claude Code versions write; older ones keep the 90-second rule
Fixed • Codex sub-agents now appear inside the session that started them, instead of as separate sessions • pi sub-agents (pi-subagents) are now counted: their tokens and cost belong to the session that started them, and were missing before • Suggest tailnet hosts now says why it lists nothing on a Mac that has the Tailscale app but no Tailscale command-line tool, and points to adding a machine by name • Machines added under Remote Sessions need actvt-cli 0.10.1 to fold their sub-agents the same way, and Settings offers the update

New • Actvt alerts you as a Claude or Codex plan limit nears, at 80% by default, and again when it's reached. Choose the level, or turn it off, under Settings > General > Notifications • A long session on another machine now reads back to its first prompt: scroll to the top, or press ⌘↑. That machine needs actvt-cli 0.10.0, and Settings offers the update
Improved • Agents reading Actvt over MCP get the same answers in about 40% fewer tokens
Fixed • A session folder Actvt briefly can't read, such as an unmounted drive, no longer drops its sessions from search and then re-indexes all of them

New • On Apple Silicon the CPU card shows the chip's power in watts. Hover it for CPU, GPU and Neural Engine, and agents reading Actvt over MCP get the same numbers in the snapshot and in history
Fixed • Claude Code background jobs and forked sessions no longer count the parent conversation's spend a second time • A Claude Code session resumed at the prompt, a terminal running a background copy, and a background handoff now show the right live state • Find (⌘F) in a session over 25 MB searches the whole session, not only the part on screen, and ⌘G opens each match
